Summary: Key performance Q3 Y2025 
T.KRUNGTHAI  INDUSTRIES  PLC. 181.Q3Sales decreased from same period of prior year 9.1% and lower than Projection 10.8% 
mainly from both plastic sales and mold sales decreased.
2.% Gross profit (16.6%) was improved from same period of prior year (16.3%) 
3.Cost reduction achievement: Control and manage DL/OH/SG&A cost.
4.Got new opportunity from (EV Tier#2 BYD) and new electronic customer.
5.Continue improve knowledge and skills of staffs and improve engineering skills to serve 
new models.
